Subject: Re: Marketplace listing — region lock + deletion requirements

Sam — thanks for the clear ask. High-level answers up front, then details below.

- Can we region-lock marketplace data? Yes. For marketplace listings we offer region affinity controls: requests routed to hosted instances in the customer-specified region (US, EU, APAC) and may be pinned to a cloud region (AWS us-east-1, GCP us-east4, Azure eastus) per the commercial agreement. Note: full region isolation (no cross-region backups) is available on Dedicated/Private but for hosted Marketplace we may keep cold snapshots in a geographically proximate region for DR unless the customer purchases the dedicated/no-cross-region option.

- Default retention: 30 days for request logs and ephemeral KV caches; 90 days for metadata and usage analytics. Embeddings/transcripts: configurable — default 90 days.

- Deletion timeline: policy deletion requests are processed within 48 hours; full asynchronous purge from live serving storage within 7 days; low-level backups/snapshots may be purged on their standard cadence (up to 90 days) unless the customer has the accelerated deletion add-on which shortens snapshot retention to 14 days.

Below are the per-cloud notes and a short checklist attached (region-locking-checklist.pdf) plus a CSV mapping (deletion-timeline-table.csv). If Procurement needs edited language for the SOW, flag which level of guarantee you need (marketplace-hosted vs dedicated/private) and I’ll coordinate with Legal.

AWS
- Region pinning supported to specific AZ region choices when customer selects the regional option on the listing. We use multi-AZ within that region for availability; cross-region replication only occurs for DR snapshots (can be disabled on dedicated).

GCP
- Similar region pinning. Note that some managed services we leverage (metrics backend) are regionalized but may route telemetry to a central ingestion endpoint in the US unless telemetry retention is opted-out.

Azure
- Region pinning supported. For gov/high-compliance tenants we recommend Dedicated/Private with HSM-backed KMS.

Next steps: I’ve attached a short checklist you can drop into the SOW. Vanessa, Sergio — would appreciate a quick legal/ops read to confirm the language is acceptable for marketplace listing (we want to avoid promises about snapshot deletion beyond our standard products unless we add the dedicated option).

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — quick legal ops note and suggested wording for the SOW. Quoting Marissa below.

> - Deletion timeline: policy deletion requests are processed within 48 hours; full asynchronous purge from live serving storage within 7 days; low-level backups/snapshots may be purged on their standard cadence (up to 90 days) unless the customer has the accelerated deletion add-on which shortens snapshot retention to 14 days.

Suggested SOW clause (marketplace-hosted offering):
"Redwood will process data deletion requests within 48 hours. Redwood will remove data from primary serving infrastructure within seven (7) calendar days. Backups and archived snapshots are retained per Redwood's backup retention policy and may remain for up to ninety (90) days; customers requiring complete removal of backups must purchase the accelerated deletion add-on or choose a Dedicated/Private deployment which can be configured for no cross-region backups."

Operational caveats: 1) We should not commit to instantaneous deletion from immutable backup media; 2) For cross-cloud region-locking language, replace "per region" with "per cloud-region where supported" and add the following: "Region pinning is subject to the selected marketplace configuration and available infrastructure in the chosen cloud provider."

Sergio, can you confirm the timeline numbers for processing and technical steps? If Legal wants this softer or stronger, call it out and I’ll iterate.

-Vanessa
